strings.subtitle: — Mobebisi ya bafɛlɛ —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Bobombi mpe botiki ezali te. Salela butó ya nse.
strings.shred_button: B E B I S A
strings.ssd_warning:
Likebisi! Na SSD nzela ya kokoma likolo ezali kolakisa te ete ebebisami mpo na TRIM.
Programɛ oyo ezali mpo na HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fɛlɛ "{name}" ekokomama likolo mpe elongolama.

Kokoba?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Oyo ezali shortcut (.lnk). Kaka shortcut ekobebisama.

Fichiye ya nsuka ekolakisama ezali malamu.

Koba?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Oyo ezali network drive (\\server\share).
Kokoma na ba secteur ekopesa garantie te — serveur ekoki kozala na snapshot, deduplication to CoW.

Koba?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Oyo ezali removable drive (USB / HDD ya libanda).
Controller ekoki kobomba ba block ya kala na reserve.

Koba?
strings.report_limits:
• Mikɔlɔ ya nsango mosusu ya NTFS (ADS) esalemi te.
• Zulunalo USN epetolami te.
• Bakopi ya elili mpe bosangisi ya mapata
  (OneDrive mpe bongo) ezali na bopusi te.
strings.status_full: Makambo manzoto makomami mobimba na nzelo. Bozongisi ekoki te — bisaleli bikomonaka kaka nzelo.
strings.status_fast: Motó, mokila mpe milɔngɔ 4 MB makomami likolo. Oyo etikali ebangami te, kasi mpo na bipai, bozongisi mobimba na bisaleli ya batɛkɛ ezali te. Mpo na mikanda ya sekele salela lolenge MOBIMBA.
strings.status_empty: Fɛlɛ ezalaki mpamba, kokoma likolo esengelaki te. Elongolami.
strings.error_permission: Ekoki kokota na fichiye te. Ekoki kozala efunami na programe mosusu. Funga yango mpe meka lisusu.
strings.error_not_found: Fichiye emonanaki te. Ekoki kozala ebebisami.
strings.error_is_symlink: Oyo ezali symbolic link. Ba link ekoki kobebisama te — fichiye ya nsuka ekolakisama ezali malamu.
strings.error_reparse: Oyo ezali placeholder fichiye (OneDrive to ndenge moko). Ba data na yango ezali na cloud, na disque te — eloko ya kobebisa ezali te.
strings.error_not_file: Oyo ezali fichiye te (dosie to eloko mosusu). Bomba fichiye.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fichiye oyo ezali na ba hard link mosusu ({n} nyonso). Ba hard link ezali na ya liboso te — ba nkombo nyonso ekokani. Soki obebisi na nzela ya lelo, ba data ekokomama mpe ekokatamaka tii 32 bytes, kasi stub ekokaki kokota na ba link mosusu. Longola ba link nyonso liboso.
strings.error_compressed:
Fichiye ekomami, efinamaki to ezali sparse. Kokoma na zéro epesi garantie te mpo NTFS ebombaka yango ndenge mosusu.

Longola attribut: clic ya mobali → Propriétés → Avancé → longola 'Compress' mpe/to 'Encrypt'. Sima, salá SHREDDER lisusu.
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Ekotika sima ya fichiye ya lelo...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Bafichiye {count} ekobebisama.
Bonene nyonso: {size}.

Tala molongo liboso ya kokoba.
Mosala oyo ekoki kozongisama te.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Longola bafichiye nyonso {count} na molongo?

Bafichiye moko ekosimbama te — kaka molongo.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fichiye "{name}" ezali na hard link mosusu ({nlink} nyonso).

Ba data ekobebisama mpo na nkombo nyonso.
Kasi bitikali (32 bytes) ekotikala na nse ya nkombo mosusu na dosie.

Okoki kosenga kolongola bitikali oyo na maboko.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Salela na ba hard link nyonso na molongo
